{{Top|ca|leg}}
'''Amber-root''' was a type of cooking ingredient that could be diced.<ref name="IC">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref> In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]'' to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> [[Jilka Zan Zentis]], a worker at the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Republic Treasury/Legends|Treasury]], diced amber-root in preparation for a meal while she was living in [[Kyrimorut/Legends|Kyrimorut]], the home of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Clan Skirata|Skirata clan]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalore]].<ref name="IC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Amber-root appeared in ''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]'', a [[2009]] novel written by [[Karen Traviss]] and released in [[2009]] as a continuation of the [[Republic Commando|''Republic Commando'' series]].<ref name="IC" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]'' {{1st}}
